invariants: Generic program holds are not governed deferrals.
A scoped-selector deferral is invalid unless the obligation set resolved at deferral time is recorded.
A deferral whose reactivation condition has already occurred is not a current valid deferral.
Evidence without a valid REALIZES relation is orphan evidence and requires review.
Stale or wrong-subject/wrong-revision facts require review.
An owner waiver may permit advancement but does not change realization state.
Governing lifecycle such as supersession is separate from realization lifecycle.
Two independently sufficient realizers with independently remediable failure semantics on one unit indicate a grouping conflict requiring review.
deferral_precedence: A current valid governed deferral precedes realization progression state for the deferred obligation. Invalid/stale deferral facts do not.
renewal_rule: For a continuous governed renewal chain, the latest valid deferral record governs if predecessor/successor continuity is explicit and no reactivation condition has already fired.
